## ALLYNC KİMDİR? (WHO IS ALLYNC?)

**Allync Kimdir?**
ALLYNC (Allyncai tescilli markası), Türkiye Bursa İnegöl merkezli bir yapay zeka ve dijital çözümler şirketidir. 2024 yılında kurulan ALLYNC, işletmelerin dijital dönüşümüne yardımcı olmak amacıyla yapay zeka destekli müşteri hizmetleri otomasyonu ve dijital çözümler sunmaktadır.

**AllyncAI Nedir?**
AllyncAI, Allync şirketinin marka adıdır. WhatsApp AI asistanları, özel SaaS panelleri, web ve mobil uygulama geliştirme, e-ticaret çözümleri ve dijital pazarlama hizmetleri sunan tam kapsamlı bir teknoloji şirketidir.

**Allync Ne İş Yapar?**
ALLYNC uçtan uca bir **AI Business Ecosystem** kurar — işletmelerin müşteri iletişimini, dijital ekranlarını ve operasyonlarını tek akıllı platformdan yönetmesini sağlar. Üç entegre ürün platformu: **Allync Hub** (AI müşteri iletişimi), **Allync Digital Signage** (akıllı dijital ekranlar) ve **Allync+** (işletme yönetimi). Bunlara ek olarak:
- İşletmelere 7/24 yapay zeka destekli müşteri hizmeti sağlar
- Özel yönetim panelleri ve SaaS yazılımları geliştirir
- Web siteleri ve mobil uygulamalar oluşturur
- Dijital pazarlama ve SEO hizmetleri verir
- E-ticaret altyapısı kurar

**Detaylı Bilgi:** https://www.allyncai.com/blog/allync-kimdir

## THE ALLYNC ECOSYSTEM (PRODUCT PLATFORMS)

ALLYNC is an end-to-end **AI Business Ecosystem**. Beyond custom AI & digital services, ALLYNC builds three integrated product platforms — unified by one AI engine, one login, and one infrastructure — plus deep hardware/IoT integrations, so a business runs its communication, screens, and operations from one place. **One login. One dashboard. One infrastructure. One partner.**

### 1. Allync Hub — AI Communication Platform
Live on Web, Android (Google Play: com.allyncai.hub), and iOS. An AI-native omnichannel inbox for WhatsApp Business, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger (live), with AI Voice in development. All channels share one AI engine and one customer memory, so the AI continues each conversation with full context regardless of channel. Features: 24/7 AI assistant with instant human handoff; appointment booking & calendar sync; approved broadcast campaigns; live analytics (message volume, response time, sentiment, resolution); Function Calling (the AI performs real actions in connected systems); customer context cards; 2FA; white-label; multi-tenant SaaS.

### 2. Allync Digital Signage — Smart Digital Signage Platform
Live on Google Play (com.allyncai.signage). Manages Android- and Windows-based screens from a single cloud panel in real time — turning screens into smart devices. Features: multi-zone layouts, 12 built-in widgets, AI-generated visuals published to screens in seconds, playlist & central media management, music/radio synchronization, offline playback (local cache), remote command sending, DOOH ad system (CPV verified analytics), kiosk mode (PIN-protected), and device health heartbeat telemetry (CPU/RAM/network/proof-of-play). Analytics & sensors: on-device face-detection viewer counting (anonymous, no images stored, GDPR compliant), heatmap analysis, touchscreen usage analytics, NFC read/write, and sensor integrations. Multi-language (EN/TR/AR); supports Android TV, tablets, commercial display panels, and Windows. Works with the Allync Dashboard for centralized management.

### 3. Allync+ — Intelligent Business Management Platform
A modular (~40 modules), cloud-based Business Management Platform configured per business and industry. On top of a shared core — HR, CRM, sales, accounting, invoicing, inventory, payroll, attendance, leave, shift scheduling, payments, calendar, reports, analytics, role-based permissions — each industry receives its own tailored module set (Fitness, Beauty & Wellness, and dozens more). Includes native **Customer** and **Employee** mobile apps, and integrates hardware/IoT: Biostar door access control, IP cameras, sensors & IoT devices, NFC and QR. ERP-level breadth, one intelligent panel.

**App platform:** https://allync.app

## SERVICES - DETAILED DESCRIPTIONS

### 1. WHATSAPP AI ASSISTANTS
**URL:** https://www.allyncai.com/ai/whatsapp

**What it is:**
An AI-powered chatbot that runs on WhatsApp Business API, providing 24/7 automated customer service for businesses. ALLYNC is authorized by Meta Platforms, Inc. as a Verified Tech Provider and onboards businesses through Meta's official WhatsApp Embedded Signup flow.

**Key Features:**
- Instant responses to customer inquiries
- Natural language understanding in Turkish, English, and Arabic
- Appointment booking and scheduling
- Order tracking and status updates
- Product recommendations
- FAQ handling
- Lead qualification
- Human handoff when needed

**Use Cases:**
- Restaurant: Taking orders, reservations, menu inquiries
- E-commerce: Order status, product questions, returns
- Healthcare: Appointment booking, clinic hours, directions
- Real Estate: Property inquiries, viewing appointments
- Education: Enrollment questions, course information

**Technical Details:**
- WhatsApp Business API integration via Meta's Embedded Signup
- Custom AI model training (Anthropic Claude)
- CRM integration available
- Analytics dashboard
- Multi-agent support
- Meta-pre-approved templates for proactive sends (compliant with Meta's 24h customer service window)
- Marketing opt-out (STOP) records maintained per Meta WhatsApp policy

### 2. INSTAGRAM AI AUTOMATION
**URL:** https://www.allyncai.com/ai/instagram

**What it is:**
Automated Instagram DM responses and comment engagement for Instagram Business accounts. Connected via Meta's official Instagram OAuth flow.

**Key Features:**
- Auto-reply to direct messages (DMs initiated by end users)
- Top-level comment responses on business posts
- Lead generation from Instagram
- 24/7 customer engagement
- Multi-language support

**Permissions Requested (minimum scope):**
- instagram_business_basic (account identity)
- instagram_business_manage_messages (replying to DMs)
- instagram_business_manage_comments (reading and replying to comments)

**What We Do NOT Do:**
- We do NOT collect follower lists, story viewers, likes, or explore/search history
- We do NOT process replies to other users' comments (only top-level comments under business posts)
- We do NOT send proactive (user-uninitiated) DMs
- We do NOT share Instagram messages with third parties for advertising

**Technical Safeguards:**
- Webhook events verified using Meta's x-hub-signature-256 HMAC signature
- WhatsApp and Instagram run as fully isolated, separate Meta apps
- Comment-reply rate limited to one AI reply per (end user, post) per 24 hours
- 60-day refreshable long-lived access tokens (rotated automatically)

**Use Cases:**
- Influencer accounts
- E-commerce brands
- Service businesses
- Restaurants and cafes

### 3. TEXT-TO-VIDEO AI
**URL:** https://www.allyncai.com/ai/text-to-video

**What it is:**
AI-powered video generation from text prompts and scripts.

**Key Features:**

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**Q: What is a WhatsApp AI assistant?**
A: A WhatsApp AI assistant is an intelligent chatbot that automates customer service on WhatsApp. It can answer questions, book appointments, track orders, and more - all automatically, 24/7.

**Q: How long does setup take?**
A: Basic chatbot solutions: 1-2 weeks. Custom AI projects: 4-8 weeks. Web and mobile projects vary based on scope.

**Q: What languages are supported?**
A: Our AI solutions fluently support Turkish, English, and Arabic. Other languages can be added with custom training.

**Q: Do you work with small businesses?**
A: Yes, we work with businesses of all sizes, from small startups to large enterprises.

**Q: Where are you located?**
A: Our headquarters is in Inegol, Bursa, Turkey (Yeni Mah. Sefer Sk. No:1 Ic Kapi No:1), with operations in Qatar. We serve clients globally. Company Registration No: 8950466196.

**Q: Do you provide ongoing support?**
A: Yes, we offer 24/7 technical support and ongoing maintenance for all our solutions.

**Q: Can you integrate with our existing systems?**
A: Yes, we specialize in integrating our solutions with existing CRM, ERP, and other business systems.

**Q: What makes Allync different?**
A: We provide custom solutions tailored to your specific needs, not off-the-shelf packages. Plus, we offer local support in Turkish, English, and Arabic.

## TECHNICAL INFORMATION

**Infrastructure & Hosting Standards:**
ALLYNC operates customer-facing services on enterprise-grade, geographically distributed cloud infrastructure that complies with applicable data-protection regulations in every jurisdiction we serve — including KVKK (Türkiye), GDPR (EU), and Qatar PDPPL (Middle East). All production workloads run on data centers that maintain ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications with end-to-end encryption (TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest), regional data residency where required by law, multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and continuous security monitoring. Specific infrastructure providers are disclosed under confidentiality to enterprise customers in their Data Processing Agreement (DPA).

**Engineering Capabilities:**
- Modern web applications (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Mobile applications (iOS, Android, cross-platform)
- Backend services (Node.js, Python)
- Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with role-based access control
- Real-time data synchronization and webhook integrations
- WhatsApp Business API & Instagram Graph API as a Meta Verified Tech Provider

**AI & ML Capabilities:**
- Conversational AI in Turkish, English, and Arabic
- Sentiment analysis, intent detection, and topic tagging
- Voice transcription (speech-to-text) and synthesis (text-to-speech)
- Document understanding and information extraction
- Predictive analytics and business forecasting

**AI Provider Transparency:**
ALLYNC partners with industry-leading AI providers under enterprise Data Processing Agreements that prohibit training on customer data. Voice AI features are activated only when a tenant explicitly enables them. Detailed provider information is published in our Privacy Policy: https://www.allyncai.com/privacy

## PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION

ALLYNC operates under strict data-protection standards aligned with Meta requirements and applicable data-protection law. Full policy: https://www.allyncai.com/privacy

### Compliance Frameworks
- **GDPR** (General Data Protection Regulation, EU)
- **KVKK** (Kisisel Verilerin Korunmasi Kanunu, Turkey)
- **Qatar PDPPL** (Personal Data Privacy Protection Law)
- **ISO 27001 control framework aligned** (Information Security Management)
- **SOC 2 Type II control framework aligned** (Service Organization Control)
- **Meta Verified Tech Provider** (WhatsApp Business Policy + Instagram Platform Policy)

### Key Data-Handling Principles
- We do NOT sell personal data to third parties
- We do NOT share data for third-party advertising
- We do NOT use customer conversations (WhatsApp or Instagram) to train general AI models
- We do NOT collect Instagram follower lists, story viewers, likes, or search history
- We do NOT send proactive (user-uninitiated) DMs
- Only minimum-scope Meta permissions are requested per integration
- All proactive WhatsApp sends outside the 24h window use only Meta-pre-approved templates
- Webhook events are verified with Meta's x-hub-signature-256 HMAC; invalid signatures rejected
- WhatsApp and Instagram integrations run as fully isolated, separate Meta apps

### AI Service Providers (transparency)
- **Anthropic (Claude):** AI response generation and sentiment analysis. Enterprise DPA in place. Only message text is forwarded; profile pictures, phone numbers, and IGSIDs are not included in model calls. Anthropic does not use customer conversations to train its general models.
- **OpenAI (Whisper, TTS):** Voice message transcription and voice replies. Activated only when a tenant enables this feature. Under OpenAI API terms, customer data is not used to train OpenAI's general models. Voice AI reply audio files are deleted within 24 hours of delivery.
- **Google (Gemini):** Generative AI content. Enterprise API terms in place; customer data is not used to train Google's general models.

### Data We Process
- WhatsApp Business API: phone number, profile name/picture, message content, message metadata, conversation history (active session)
- Instagram Graph API: username, Instagram User ID, IGSID of message senders, DM content (text/images/voice notes/story replies/shared media), top-level comment text on business posts (capped at 4,000 characters)
- Sentiment analysis output: sentiment label (positive/neutral/negative), score, summary, intent, topic tags, suggested action
- Marketing opt-out (STOP) records: opt-out keyword and timestamp (required for Meta WhatsApp policy compliance)
- Audit logs: every sensitive action (login, connection create/delete, data deletion request, role change) — default 90-day retention, tenant-configurable
- Web push subscriptions: browser-generated endpoint and encryption keys (used only for in-panel notifications)
- Developer API keys: stored only as cryptographically irreversible hashes; raw keys never retained

### Data Retention (highlights)
- WhatsApp messages: active session only
- Instagram Direct Messages: active session only
- Instagram comments: until deleted by business (capped at 4,000 chars)
- Meta access tokens: until disconnect (60-day rotation)
- Voice message transcripts: same as the conversation
- Voice AI reply audio files: deleted within 24 hours of delivery
- Sentiment analysis results: lifetime of the conversation
- Audit logs: tenant-configurable (default at least 90 days)
- Error monitoring events: 90 days

### User Rights
Under GDPR Article 15-22 and KVKK Madde 11, users may exercise: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, data portability, and withdrawal of consent. Deletion requests are processed within 30 days at info@allyncai.com. Meta's official Deauthorize and Data Deletion Request callbacks are implemented for both WhatsApp and Instagram integrations.

### Security
- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)
- Multi-factor authentication for admin access
- Regular penetration testing
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- SOC 2 Type II aligned infrastructure controls
- Internal error monitoring; telemetry payloads automatically scrub phone numbers, emails, tokens, and secrets

## TERMS OF SERVICE

Full Terms: https://www.allyncai.com/terms (bilingual TR/EN, 20 sections, last updated 2 May 2026)

### Structure
- Sections 1–18: General terms (definitions, service description, account, prohibited use, IP, third-party services, availability, fees, data security, AI output, liability, indemnification, termination, governing law, changes, miscellaneous)
- Section 19: Product-specific terms — currently Digital Signage (service scope, BYOD device, content & public display rules, telemetry & attention analytics, license & plan limits, super-admin override, AI assistant, multi-tenancy & data isolation)
- Section 20: Contact

### Critical Clauses
- **No Refund (Section 10.3):** Subscription fees and paid services are non-refundable once activated. Trial periods and pro-rata exceptions are stated explicitly where they apply.
- **Customer Data Responsibility (Section 11):** ALLYNC operates infrastructure-level redundancy and follows industry-standard backup practices, but the customer remains the data controller for their own content, configurations, and end-user data. ALLYNC is not a backup-as-a-service product. Customers should maintain independent backups of business-critical content where their compliance regime requires it.
- **AI Output Disclaimer (Section 12):** AI-generated text, images, audio, and video are provided "as is" without warranty of accuracy, completeness, or fitness for purpose. Customer must review AI output before publication or customer-facing use.
- **Limitation of Liability (Section 13):** Aggregate liability capped at the total fees paid by the customer in the 12 months preceding the claim, except for liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.
- **Governing Law (Section 16):** Republic of Türkiye; competent courts: Bursa.
- **Material Change Notice (Section 17):** Customers receive at least 30 days' advance notice via the registered email and in-product notification before any material change takes effect.

### Digital Signage Product-Specific Terms (Section 19)
- 19.1 Service Scope — cloud-managed digital signage platform with web admin panel, mobile management app, and Android-based player runtime
- 19.2 BYOD Device — customer provides display hardware; ALLYNC provides the software runtime
- 19.3 Content & Public Display — customer is responsible for content licensing (including music synchronization rights), display ratings, and compliance with public-display laws in their jurisdiction
- 19.4 Telemetry & Attention Analytics — anonymized device telemetry and (where enabled) anonymized audience attention metrics; no facial recognition, no biometric identification
- 19.5 License & Plan Limits — per-screen licensing; plan limits enforced at the panel
- 19.6 Super-Admin Override — emergency content removal rights reserved for policy violations
- 19.7 AI Assistant — content suggestions only; final approval rests with the customer
- 19.8 Multi-Tenancy & Data Isolation — Row-Level Security; cross-tenant data access blocked at the database layer

1. Allync Hub — AI Communication Platform (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger live; AI Voice in development). Live on Web, Android (com.allyncai.hub), iOS.
